A tennis player wins again in Beijing.

Serbian tennis player Novak Djokovic has won the China Open men's singles title in Beijing for the seventh time. The final took place on Tuesday against Australian player Alex de Minaur. Djokovic had already won difficult matches on his way to the final.

He took the first set after a close finish. De Minaur was leading at the start of the second set, but an injury meant he could not continue. The match ended early, and Djokovic received the title. It was a different ending from a final played all the way through.

Djokovic is thirty-nine. His previous China Open title was in twenty fifteen, eleven years before this latest win. The report describes him as the event's most successful male singles player. His return added another victory to a long record in Beijing.
